faq.title: A few things before you begin
faq.nas.question: Do I need a NAS?
faq.nas.answer: No. Pome Panel works locally on your computer. A NAS is an optional companion for syncing across devices.
faq.platform.question: Which desktop platforms are supported?
faq.platform.answer: macOS 13+ on Apple Silicon, and Windows 10 / 11 x64. Available installers are listed in GitHub Releases.
faq.demo.question: Can this page control the desktop app?
faq.demo.answer: This is an interactive website prototype. Page switching and expansion illustrate the experience; use the desktop app for the actual workspace features.
